verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a product specification object with an approval state, or a way to pull an approved spec into the delivery workflow to start implementation. The closest items are adjacent: turning customer feedback into issues, delegating issues to agents, an MCP server that reads issues, projects and documents, and 'Merge approved changes', which is about code review rather than spec approval.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull an approved product specification into the delivery workflow to start implementation
